headline: Sensex slips as Nifty gains; Metals and Smallcaps shine amid Fed jitters
why: Higher US Treasury yields weighing on global investor sentiment
AAII survey indicating investor sentiment at a 16-month low
IT sector dragging performance ahead of the Federal Reserve call
BofA warning of potential Fed rate hikes exceeding 5 percent
whatHappening: Sensex ended 22 points lower while Nifty 50 gained 53 points
Smallcap stocks outperformed the broader market with a 1.8 percent jump
Metal and FMCG sectors showed strength despite overall market volatility
SBI reports potential 5 trillion rupee profit for banks from FCNR(B)

stocksInNews.sources: SBI report on FCNR(B) notional profit

summary: Indian markets displayed mixed results as Nifty edged higher while Sensex remained flat to negative. Smallcap and metal stocks provided significant support, offsetting losses in the technology sector. Global factors like rising Treasury yields and Fed policy uncertainty continue to dictate trends.
